project.title: ADP Payroll Systems Migration (Citrix Virtualization, Platform Upgrade, Database Migration)

parentsummary.deliverables: Led the enterprise-wide consolidation of payroll services onto the ADP platform across 9 physical sites in the United States and Canada, delivering Citrix Desktop streaming infrastructure, RBAC access controls for HR and Finance systems, and full ISO:27001 and NIST compliance alignment.
parentsummary.outcomes: Consolidated cross-border HR and Finance access via Citrix virtualization following 60% organizational growth, implementing RBAC access controls and achieving ISO:27001 and NIST compliance across all nine sites.

challenge.summary: The client had expanded its market share and physical locations by 60%, onboarding nine physical sites across the United States and Canada. ADP was selected for consolidated payroll services.

deliverables: Needs analysis, define requirements, and vendors requirements
Vendor Management and advisory services for integration
Security Coordination and alignment for finance and payroll requirements
Provisioning of supporting infrastructure and Citrix Desktop streaming services
Staged integration of new services with existing infrastructure, and inline remediation
Cutover and migration of data and access
Facilitated requirements gathering between HR teams, finance teams, executives, external vendors and IT teams
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Compliance required for ISO:27001 and NIST
Designed and governed the RBAC-based Access Control Program for Corporate HR and Payroll systems, ensuring ISO:27001 and NIST compliance across all nine sites
Documentation preparation and training for Operations staff, HR Staff, and Finance Staff

outcomes: ✅ Consolidated ADP payroll services across 9 physical sites in the United States and Canada following 60% growth, delivering cross-border HR and Finance access via Citrix virtualization
✅ Implemented RBAC access controls meeting ISO:27001 and NIST compliance
